marine.title: Forecast for Today Tonight and Thursday.
marine.text:
Wind east 20 knots diminishing to east 15 this afternoon and to
light early this evening. Wind becoming northwest 15 this evening. Wind
northwest 15 Thursday. Scattered showers. Fog patches forming near noon and
dissipating Thursday morning. <br/>
